g.text: The 12 single words and 6 two-word terms most over-represented in the passages where each classifier fires alone, versus

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: passages where only the other two fire. Grey figures under each term are its rate per 10,000 words in this class versus

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the other two combined. Distributive justice reads as mitigation vocabulary rather than allocation vocabulary — a finding

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: about where distributive claims sit in this corpus, not a defect: the classifier was built so it would not need the word "equity".

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Log-odds ratio with informative Dirichlet prior (Monroe, Colaresi & Quinn 2008), z-scored; prior from the unlabelled corpus. English stopwords plus legal boilerplate removed, min. 25 occurrences.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: One- and two-word terms are ranked in separate vocabularies: a two-word term is necessarily rarer than either of its parts, so in a pooled ranking the prior shrinks it harder and almost none survive.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: Climate Policy Radar, PRODUCTION.PUBLISHED.PASSAGES (Snowflake), Aug 2026. Body text passages only (content_type='Text', >=20 chars), published non-principal documents. Samples of 54,651 / 59,104 / 36,299 deduplicated exclusive passages.
